response: The continuation of pregnancy after antenatal corticosteroid administration may present an opportunity for rescue, but it's essential to note that this opportunity, referred to as "rescue AC," may only apply to a limited percentage of cases, approximately 18%. Research has identified specific subsets of patients who are more likely to be candidates for this rescue option. This implies that not all pregnancies that have been administered antenatal corticosteroids will qualify for rescue, and careful selection based on specific criteria is necessary to determine which patients could benefit from this approach.
